name: nexusbot-lottery-mcp
description: Lotterymcp monorepo for P3 history, MCP access, and deterministic analysis

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace lotterymcp-web && tsc -b packages/core packages/mcp-server packages/cli && node scripts/copy-web-assets.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/banner-render.test.mjs tests/cli-help.test.mjs tests/core-client.test.mjs tests/data-files.test.mjs tests/mcp-server.test.mjs tests/official-sync.test.mjs tests/pl3-experiments.test.mjs tests/pl3-features.test.mjs tests/pl3-prediction.test.mjs tests/pl3-store.test.mjs tests/publish-package.test.mjs && npm run test --workspace lotterymcp-web
